narrative.overview: What a family wants to verify sits behind frosted glass, and AMBA's verdict is what clears it. Glass is reserved for surfaces with something under them: the sticky header, the checker, the verdict lens over the user's own content, the error pane. Everything else is a quieter translucent pane or plain type on warm light. The palette is Claude-like and restrained (ivory and charcoal, one terracotta accent); light and dark are both glass and the device chooses.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass only where something is under it
One terracotta accent: primary action, focus, risk meter
Verdict colours always with an icon and words
Lists on hairlines, not grids of equal cards
Page light: three soft fields and a fine grain, fixed to the viewport

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta marks the action and the focus, nothing else; selections are raised neutral segments.

rules.name: The Composite Rule
rules.body: Checked colour tokens are the opaque colour a glass pane composites to; translucency lives only in --glass-* tokens.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading as a kicker; codes and categories go below the copy.

rules.name: The Earned Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter appears only on the header, the checker, the verdict lens and the error pane.

dos: Do show the thing being checked beside its verdict.
Do keep terracotta for the primary action and focus.
Do put lists of equal items on hairlines.
Do theme selection, caret, scrollbar and focus from the palette.
Do check both themes; the device chooses by default.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't blur a pane that has nothing under it.
Don't use a black page with a neon accent, an accented headline word, three numbered step cards or a closing CTA band.
Don't use coloured side stripes, gradient text, glow as depth or hard offset shadows.
Don't animate width, height or padding.
